verdict.rationale: Jitsu delivers raw events to ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, Postgres, S3 and GCS, either streamed or micro-batched, with optional batching and automatic table and column creation. Profile Builder writes customer profile records into your own warehouse, and a community user confirms hands-on delivery into BigQuery. Control over the schedule is only implied: the docs mention optional batching and warehouse batch jobs, and say the mode depends on what the destination prefers. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of user-configurable batch frequency or schedule, and independent corroboration of profile delivery and of the Snowflake, ClickHouse and S3 paths.
